title: Press and licensing
desc: How to license Everett Allen Photography images for publications, organizations and social media.
lede: Using my photos in a publication, a program or a post.
body:
All photos on this site are copyrighted by Everett Allen Photography. Here is how to use them the right way.

**Publications and press.** I provide event photos to community publications and media. A license lets you use specific photos for a specific purpose, such as an article, a feature or a cover. It is a license to use the photos, not a sale of them. Tell me the publication, the photos or gallery you need, and how you plan to use them, and I'll get back to you.

**Organizations and event producers.** If you run an event and want photos for your website, newsletter, program or sponsors, get in touch and we'll work out what you need.

**Social media.** Sharing a photo of yourself or a friend on your own social accounts is welcome. Please credit it as "Photo by Everett Allen Photography," tag me, and leave the watermark and credit in place. Ask first before using a photo for advertising, merchandise or anything that makes money.

**Credit.** Every use needs the credit line: *Photo by Everett Allen Photography.*

For any of the above, use the [contact page](/contact/) and include the gallery name and where you plan to use the photos.
